methodology.headline: Available default-scope APIs divided by all default-scope NumPy APIs.
methodology.default_scope: Top-level NumPy callables; ndarray public methods and properties; callable exports of numpy.random, numpy.linalg, and numpy.fft.
methodology.api_scope: Dashboard default: headline APIs plus extended public submodule callables and object methods/properties/protocols. Supporting class, constant and module exports are catalogued but excluded from API percentages.
methodology.object_members: Object members match only their explicit NumSharp owner type. Inherited members and ufunc protocols are catalogued per owner; NumPy's scalar types and the other public classes list each member once, at the class that defines it. A Python protocol is credited by a NumSharp member of its own name, the C# operator, indexer or cast of the same meaning, or a reviewed adapter. Namespace namesakes never confer support. Protocol existence does not imply applicability to every ufunc or object.
methodology.availability_note: Compiled API availability is distinct from fully verified behavioral parity.
methodology.case_sensitivity: NumPy API names are matched case-sensitively for parity. Case-insensitive near-misses are detected and reported (row field 'case_insensitive_matches'; the 'Case-insensitive near-misses' section of summary.md) but never counted as available.
methodology.oracle: Behavioral parity evidence: committed NumPy 2.4.2 oracle contracts (the differential-fuzz corpus plus the .npy, flags and layout oracles), each replayed against NumSharp in CI and required to be bit-exact or a documented, registry-excused divergence. Contracts resolve to rows through coverage/oracle_map.json; a row is oracle-verified when it is credited and has direct contracts, an identity alias (same NumPy object, same NumSharp member) or a reviewed pure-delegation alias. Host-pinned contracts are hard-gated only on the pinned host.
methodology.signature: Signature parity (row field 'signature', coverage/signature_parity.py + coverage/signature_gap.py): every credited API's NumPy signature against every C# spelling of it, joined from the API diff gap map of tools/api-parameter-parity (docs/plans/API_DIFF_GAP.md), which the generator runs on the tree: a reflection dump of every module facade and exported type, NumPy's runtime signatures completed from its .pyi stubs and numpydoc sections, and a compile probe of NumPy-style calls at C# 12 and C# 14. Identical = no mark. Marks: M a NumPy parameter no overload offers (a rename counts; M-weak: only parameters the parity plan excludes, which is not a difference), X a parameter NumPy does not have, O more than one overload, T a dtype as NPTypeCode / Type or picked by a generic type argument, B a NumPy-style call that does not compile, L null refused where NumPy's default is None (weak: only Shape refuses null and default binds), Q an integer sequence refused where NumPy's stubs allow one, N credited through another name. Spellings: module functions, members, constructors (NumPy's class call), extension methods and the typed NDArray<T>. A credited row the gap map does not compare keeps the inventory's own reflection comparison (source 'inventory', not compile-probed). Python protocols spelled as operators, indexers or casts are not compared.
